summary.name: Database (Wikipedia article)
summary.one_liner: Wikipedia overview of databases, database management systems (DBMSs), their history from navigational and relational models to NoSQL and NewSQL, and database categories.
summary.what_it_does: This is an encyclopedia article, not a software tool. It defines a database and the DBMS software that manages it, and distinguishes database, DBMS and database system. It traces the field's history from 1960s navigational (CODASYL, IMS) systems through Codd's 1970 relational model and SQL systems, to 1980s desktop databases, 1990s object databases, and 2000s NoSQL and NewSQL systems. It also lists database classifications such as in-memory, active, cloud, data warehouse and distributed databases.
notable: Traces database history from navigational CODASYL and IMS systems to Codd's 1970 relational model
Covers NoSQL, NewSQL and the CAP theorem
Lists database categories such as in-memory, cloud, and data warehouse
caveats: Describes concepts and history only; it does not document any specific database product for use
Page text is truncated before the end of the classification list
